items.name: NEOM Green Hydrogen Project marketing and distribution agreement with Yara
items.claim: Air Products finalized a marketing and distribution agreement with Yara for renewable ammonia from the NEOM Green Hydrogen Project in Saudi Arabia.
items.source_excerpt: Signed NEOM Green Hydrogen Project agreement: Finalized marketing and distribution agreement with Yara for renewable ammonia from the NEOM Green Hydrogen Project in Saudi Arabia

items.name: Exit of Louisiana Clean Energy Complex and Casa Grande, Arizona green hydrogen facility
items.claim: In the quarter ended 30 June 2026, Air Products recognized project exit charges of approximately $2.9 billion pre-tax associated with actions announced on 30 June 2026, including the exit of a clean energy complex under construction in Louisiana and a green hydrogen production facility under construction in Casa Grande, Arizona.
items.source_excerpt: During the quarter ended 30 June 2026, the Company recognized project exit charges of approximately $2.9 billion pre-tax ($2.2 billion after-tax, or $9.92 per share) associated with actions announced on 30 June 2026, including the exit of a clean energy complex under construction in Louisiana and a green hydrogen production facility under construction in Casa Grande, Arizona, as well as certain other smaller-scale clean energy distribution projects.
